stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class): 4,963 applied (2,233 men + 2,730 women), 3,573 admitted (72%; 1,519 + 2,054), 466 enrolled (204 + 262). No Common Data Set for 2024-25 or 2025-26 was found: the college's Common Data Sets folder (linked from its Institutional Effectiveness and Analytics page) ends with 2023-24, which is added as a separate year. The international split, GPA, waitlist and early-round counts for fall 2024 are therefore left blank. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (76 students = 16% sent SAT, 27 = 6% sent ACT); Muhlenberg has been test-optional since 1996. College Navigator gives no combined SAT total. Undergraduate enrollment (1,737) and the 20 nonresident undergraduates are IPEDS fall 2024 (Urban Institute portal, race code 8); the 9-to-1 student-to-faculty ratio is from College Navigator.

stats_extra.notes: Fall 2023 entering class from the Common Data Set 2023-2024 (C1): 4,348 applied, 2,783 admitted (64%), 427 enrolled; the in-state, out-of-state and international columns add up to the totals (1,010 + 2,994 + 344; 673 + 2,055 + 55; 119 + 303 + 5). International (nonresident) first-years: 344 applied, 55 admitted (16%), 5 enrolled. Early Decision (Fall 2023): 266 applications, 199 admitted; no early action counts (0). Waitlist: 531 offered a place, 156 accepted, 1 admitted. Test submitters: SAT 33% (140 students), ACT 11% (45); that year's percentiles were SAT 1230/1320/1390, ERW 630/670/710, Math 600/640/690, ACT composite 28/30/31. GPA is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (average 3.55, all first-years reported). That CDS rated very important: rigor of record, GPA and character; important: recommendations, essay, interview, extracurriculars, talent, volunteer work and work experience; considered: class rank, test scores, first generation, alumni relation, geographic residence and level of interest; not considered: state residency and religious affiliation. This is an older year kept for the international figures; the newest figures are the fall 2024 IPEDS row.

cost.notes: First-year cost of attendance for 2026-27 from the college's Tuition and Fees page: tuition $66,930; required fees $1,058 (student activity $324 + technology $280 + health and wellness $226 + first-year orientation $228); standard double room $8,558 + Mule Unlimited meal plan $7,200 = $15,758 (the page lists many room types and five meal plans, so on-campus costs vary); books and supplies $1,600; transportation $850 + personal expenses $1,500 = $2,350. The fee, room-and-board and other-expense figures are sums of the printed lines. The page's total cost of attendance is $87,696 (2025-26: tuition $64,510). Application fee: none (see requirements). The Common Data Set 2023-24 (H6, estimated 2023-24 data) reports that 22 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $41,679, total $916,928.
